biggest_catch: Friend must complete eStatements + $1,000 aggregate direct deposits OR 25 debit transactions of $10+ within 90 days of opening.
catches: Referrer earns $50 per qualifying referral; the Customer can receive up to 5 referral bonus deposits ($250 total) per calendar year.
Friend must be a new TruNorth Bank checking customer; brings the referral slip to any TruNorth Bank office.
Within 90 days of account opening: enroll in eStatements AND have $1,000+ in aggregate direct deposits posted, OR enroll in eStatements and conduct 25+ POS debit transactions of $10 or more.
Referrer must be the tax owner on an active checking account in good standing, at least 16 years old at the time of referral.
Bonus credited to the Customer's account by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day the Friend's account was opened, if both accounts are open and in good standing.
Limited-time offer, subject to change without notice; employees not eligible; bonus payouts may be 1099 reportable.

steps: Write your name on the referral slip.
Give the slip to friends and family.
Friend brings the slip to any TruNorth Bank office and opens a new checking account.
Friend completes eStatements + $1,000 aggregate direct deposits (or 25 POS debits of $10+) within 90 days; you earn $50.
timing: Credited by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day of the Friend's account opening.
when_cash_arrives: Per official terms: Credited by the last day of the statement cycle following the 90th day of the Friend's account opening. — structural: a 90-day seasoning must elapse (paid by the statement cycle after the 90th day).
maximize: Front-load the friend's qualifying activity: terms give the friend a multi-week window, but the payout clock starts at completion — a friend who finishes in week 1 gets you paid weeks earlier.
The 90-day seasoning/hold is structural — pick a different referral program if you need money sooner.
